The doctest single-header framework is vendored for private offline unit tests.

- Upstream: https://github.com/doctest/doctest
- Version: 2.4.11
- Source: `doctest.h`, preserved byte-for-byte from the upstream release
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE.txt`
- `manifest.json` records the source size and SHA-256 digest.

The library is used only by the test target. It is not part of the installed
Portals package or any public header.
